pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Sub-polygonal to rounded dark regions with soft pixel gradients at the edges. Relative spatial area of individual patches decreases significantly from the mid-flank toward the posterior and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways forming a complex topological grid. Junction nodes are frequently visible where multiple pathways intersect. Corridor pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the visible mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, soft-edged silhouette along the dorsal contour. Individual hair-level serration is not resolvable due to image resolution and focus.
